title: Comparison of corneal endothelial cell loss during phacoemulsification using continuous anterior chamber infusion versus those using ophthalmic viscosurgical device: Randomized controlled trial

indication: Senile cataract with nuclear sclerosis up to Emery-Little grade 3, age 40-80 years; pseudoexfoliation, other ocular pathology, previous ocular surgery, pachymetry above 630 µm, ECD below 1500 cells/mm2, glaucoma and diabetic retinopathy excluded; intraoperative exclusions for long surgical/phaco time, high US power or any intraoperative complication

groups.description: Group A (ACM group): phacoemulsification under continuous anterior chamber infusion of BSS plus through an anterior chamber maintainer, without an ophthalmic viscosurgical device (the technique under evaluation); quick chop, Bausch & Lomb Millennium; randomized (random table, sealed envelopes); single surgeon
Group B (OVD group): phacoemulsification with 1% sodium hyaluronate OVD (Hyvisc) and BSS plus (standard technique); quick chop, Bausch & Lomb Millennium; randomized; single surgeon

series.baseline_label: Preoperative central corneal pachymetry of the operated eye (Table 2 'Mean (um)', Preoperative Group A); SP-2000P noncontact specular microscope, Topcon (Methods)
series.notes: Table 2 row 'Mean (um)', Group A columns Preoperative, Day 1, Day 7, Day 30 (days/30.4375); SD in the next row. Per-visit n not reported (25 eyes randomized).

series.baseline_label: Preoperative central corneal pachymetry of the operated eye (Table 2 'Mean (um)', Preoperative Group B); SP-2000P noncontact specular microscope, Topcon (Methods)
series.notes: Table 2 row 'Mean (um)', Group B columns Preoperative, Day 1, Day 7, Day 30 (days/30.4375); SD in the next row. Per-visit n not reported (25 eyes randomized).

exclusions.what: Table 2 rows 'Mean change (um)', '% change' and their SD rows

exclusions.what: Table 2 'P value' row and footnote p-values

exclusions.reason: Same preoperative values as Table 2; Table 2 cells are cited for the whole series

notes: Roles: the trial evaluates phacoemulsification with an anterior chamber maintainer and no OVD (treated) against the standard OVD technique (control).
50 eyes of 47 patients, 25 eyes per group; eyes rather than patients are the unit (some patients contribute both eyes).
The tabulated 'Mean change (um)' entries equal the differences of the tabulated means, i.e., the absolute series and the change rows are consistent.
